text:
The blanks refer to Dr. Sanduk Ruit receiving Bhutan's National Order of Merit in Gold: "December 17, 2015" fits the month/year and "Sanduk Ruit" the name, with the National Order of Merit of Bhutan in Gold completing the phrase. So the entry reads: December 17 month, and year 2015 Sanduk Ruit with the National Order of Merit of Bhutan in Gold.
CONFIDENCE: 85
